surface_verification.justification: This is a NewIterateModal form UI change (client/src/components/external/NewIssueModal/ModelTierOverrideFields.tsx) whose only server-visible effect is two new launch-body fields threaded into an existing command-string builder. Unit/jsdom tests cover the DOM and the payload-threading chain in isolation; the E2E spec (client/e2e/flows/model-tier-defaults.spec.ts, isolated-stack.mjs) proves the same UI renders correctly, the reviewer-identity block is genuinely gone, and the real /launch POST body carries codexPlanReviewModel/codexReviewModel against a real running client+server pair. The POST is intercepted (not let through) because a genuine Codex launch 400s without the Codex CLI on PATH (AC8, runtime-toggle-codex.spec.ts) — this proves the request the UI sends, not the CLI's own execution, which is unrelated to this diff.
